name: breadcrumb
useFor: Use on pages two or more levels deep (Orders, then an order, then a refund). Link every ancestor and end with BreadcrumbPage. For a long trail, fold the middle into a BreadcrumbEllipsis that opens a dropdown of the hidden steps.
constraints: A breadcrumb on a top-level page
The current page as a link
